summary: Design a YAML storage for tinydb next to JSONStorage so the ops team can hand-edit database files. The owner asked for a design first, including the YAML library and loader, with no code yet.

The agent was to read how the storages are built and say how it would build one, including the YAML library and loader. The owner said not to write it yet. No observations are recorded for the conversation, so memory shows no design, code, PR or release. The request is at the planning stage.
